caseName: Solberg v. First Nat'l Bank & Trust Co. of Williston
caseNameFull: Glenn S. SOLBERG v. FIRST NATIONAL BANK AND TRUST CO. OF WILLISTON

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed *1595until May 6, 2019, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
